headline: Nigerian Naira Records Biggest Daily Gain in Three Months After CBN Intervention
summary: The Nigerian naira appreciated by N19 against the US dollar, closing at N1,378/$ at the foreign exchange market following central bank interventions.
why: Central bank foreign exchange interventions directly influence liquidity, currency parity, and import costs in emerging market economies.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: Regulatory foreign exchange intervention directly strengthened the currency against the US dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Active intervention by the central bank in the foreign exchange market induced a sharp appreciation of the naira.
